subject: New update requires new folder layout for annotation?

messages.author: 43e2e19dd6bd2992
messages.subject: New update requires new folder layout for annotation?
parts:
Hi,

After the update (either 0.4.6 or 0.4.5, I'm not sure which, because I
hadn't this part of my code again until now), it appears that I need the
folder 'samples' under annotation Data to be able to create my
AffymetrixCelSet. I didn't realize this was now a requirement (thought
this was in production); after I made the folder, it worked correctly.
Maybe the documentation has changed online, but I thought other people
might not be aware.

Best,
Elizabeth

messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] New update requires new folder layout for annotation?
parts:
Hi Elizabeth,

thanks for this. That was bug was introduced in 0.4.6, and the
solution is to add the missing directory as you did and run it again.
Sorry about that. It has been fixed in upcoming release. The bug was
due to my early development of adding support for sample annotations
to data sets - this is still in a very early stage so don't expect
anything soon.

Cheers

Henrik
